THE G RNA BONDS TO THE TARGET DNA THROUGH COMPLEMENTARY BASE PAIRING. THIS COMPLEX THEN ATTRACTS THE CAS9 ENZYME, WHICH ACTS AS A SCISSORS TO CUT THE DNA DOUBLE STRAND AT A SPECIFIC LOCATION.
